verdict.rationale: ClickUp documents a marketplace-style integrations directory with 1,000+ tools (Slack, GitHub, HubSpot, Salesforce, Figma, Jira, Asana, etc.) plus a public API/OAuth2 and MCP server for building custom connections, directly matching the story. Missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration of the marketplace's breadth/quality and no direct evidence of an actual 'app store'-style discovery UI beyond the integrations page.
